evidence_and_choice.eligible_population: every new lead, all sources, all centers
evidence_and_choice.proposed_change: one next-contact owner per lead across centers
evidence_and_choice.expected_effect: unknown sign: not identified from history

assignment_and_execution.experimental_unit: lead (canonical lead ID across all centers)
assignment_and_execution.eligible_but_untreated: logged with reason (no consent, outside contact window, duplicate)
assignment_and_execution.exposure: owner field honoured by every center's dialer
assignment_and_execution.dialer_acknowledgement: per-dial check that the dialing center is the owner
stop_conditions: one interim look at week 4, on leads matured by then (arrived in weeks 1 and 2): stop if leads reached per lead is below current at the 1% level
any center dials outside the permitted window

evaluation.outcome_horizon: contact and quote: 14 days after lead creation; first payment: when mature
evaluation.maturity_rule: a lead counts once 14 days have passed. On real data a policy counts once its first due date has passed; in this simulation the first payment is known at issue.
evaluation.cost_definition: agent minutes per lead, from dialer handle time
evaluation.reversal_criterion: interval on leads reached per lead entirely below 1
